products.name: Cultivate™ Red Dyed TSB Ampules, 3mL
products.description:
• DIY Convenience - A la carte option allows users to customize media fill kits to match their most complex operation as specified by USP <797>.
  • Lifelike Simulation - Glass ampules are filled with red tryptic soy broth to simulate commonly used chemotherapy agents. Protect against cuts and contamination with disposable ampule breaker, 10273, sold separately.
  • Smart Packaging - Lint-free trays reduce particulate shedding in the anteroom and assist pharmacy in aseptic technique when introducing items into the cleanroom.
  • Quantity - 20 per pack

products.name: Sterile Fine Tip Markers, Pack
products.description:
• Sterile Labeling - Super fine tip waterproof markers are ideal for writing on medication labels in the pharmacy and OR. They can also be used on plastic, glass, steel and similar surfaces.
  • Seamless Compatibility - Markers can be used with sterile labels (16079 and 16072, sold separately).
  • Clean Application - Ink is permanent, smudge-free, waterproof and non-toxic.
  • Single Use - Markers are intended for single use per surgical procedure or sterile field.
  • Quantity: 25 per pack
